fusions.name: Against the Current
fusions.desc: Surges you up to 6 tiles to an enemy with a blow that deals 13 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Silver Rush
fusions.desc: Looses 3 water darts at once, spread apart. Each deals 3 damage. Its damage rises 10% for each ally beside you, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Upstream Leap
fusions.desc: Surges you 5 tiles forward, then you move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slip Then Thrash
fusions.desc: Every blow you avoid builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack, 20% at full, for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
